title: ED fever documentation

user_facing_items.final_wording: Supports suspected-infection and fever presentation documentation, source symptoms, risk factors, and recognition that sepsis can present with nonspecific illness.
user_facing_items.population: People aged 16 years and over with suspected sepsis, excluding people who are or have recently been pregnant.
user_facing_items.setting: Community, ambulance, acute hospital, and emergency assessment settings.
restrictions: Exact for suspected sepsis recognition and assessment in non-pregnant people aged 16 years and over; partial for a broad fever or suspected-infection workflow and not directly validated for UAE pathways.

user_facing_items.final_wording: Uses risk features to guide emergency referral, specialist assessment, or explicitly documented safety-netting.
user_facing_items.setting: Telehealth services in DHA-licensed health facilities.
restrictions: Direct for pediatric fever telehealth documentation; partial for a mixed-age fever/URTI workflow.

user_facing_items.final_wording: Supports temperature, heart rate, respiratory rate, blood pressure, consciousness, oxygen saturation, skin signs, urine output, fever or rigors, and examination for the suspected infection source.
user_facing_items.population: People aged 16 years and over with suspected sepsis, excluding people who are or have recently been pregnant.
user_facing_items.setting: Community, ambulance, acute hospital, and emergency assessment settings.
restrictions: Exact for suspected sepsis recognition and assessment in non-pregnant people aged 16 years and over; partial for a broad fever or suspected-infection workflow and not directly validated for UAE pathways.
user_facing_items.rationale: The exact assessment section supports measured vital data, focused assessment, illness severity and general appearance only when assessed.

user_facing_items.final_wording: Supports confusion, respiratory compromise, hypotension, tachycardia, oliguria, temperature abnormality, non-blanching or mottled skin, and immunosuppression as assessed risk features.
user_facing_items.population: People aged 16 years and over with suspected sepsis, excluding people who are or have recently been pregnant.
user_facing_items.setting: Community, ambulance, acute hospital, and emergency assessment settings.
restrictions: Exact for suspected sepsis recognition and assessment in non-pregnant people aged 16 years and over; partial for a broad fever or suspected-infection workflow and not directly validated for UAE pathways.
user_facing_items.rationale: The exact risk-criteria section supports recording time-critical symptoms or abnormal observations only when clinician-assessed; it does not generate a risk classification.

user_facing_items.final_wording: Prioritises airway, breathing, circulation, consciousness, age-specific risk, and illness-severity assessment.
user_facing_items.setting: Telehealth services in DHA-licensed health facilities.
restrictions: Direct for pediatric fever telehealth documentation; partial for a mixed-age fever/URTI workflow.
user_facing_items.rationale: The exact DHA pediatric fever assessment section independently supports severity, associated symptoms, relevant negatives and appearance when assessing a child; it is not generalized to adults.
